title: Rank Restrictions for Epipelagic Theta Lifts
body_html:
Rank Restrictions for Epipelagic Theta Lifts

If an epipelagic representation of \(G\) theta-lifts to an epipelagic representation of \(G'\), then, up to reversing the two groups, the root-system types are restricted to \[ (D_n,C_n),\quad (C_n,D_{n+1}),\quad (C_n,B_n),\quad (A_n,A_n),\quad (A_n,A_{n+1}). \] The restriction is obtained from the residual moment-map condition together with the invariant-theoretic structure of stable vectors in the corresponding Kac-Vinberg graded pieces.

deps.title: Residual Moment-Map Condition for Epipelagic Data
